title: trend block props
description: A change over time as a line that draws itself, with the moment that explains it. In predict mode the learner draws the end of the line before seeing it.
x-ai-instructions: One chart says one thing: write takeaway as the finding, set highlight to the item that proves it, keep labels short (they are translated). On a narrated screen, give items an at anchor to the word that names them (see skill elabora-charts). 2 to 40 points; a note on the point where things changed. Predict mode: hide the points after predict.from and let the learner draw them; not scored by default (an engagement moment).

takeaway.description: The sentence the chart proves, shown as its title: "Most incidents start with an email", not "Incidents by origin".

context.description: One line under the title: what is measured, where, when, in what unit.

source.description: Where the data comes from, shown under the chart.

points.description: The points, in order. x is a year or a number (spaced by value), or a word (evenly spaced).

x.description: Where on the horizontal axis: a number (a year) or a short word (Q1).

at.description: Narrated screens: the moment the line reaches this point (the line draws from the previous point's moment to this one).

unit.description: Unit written after the values (min, kg, €). "%" writes percentages as the language does (62 %, 62%).

yMax.description: Top of the scale. Default a little above the largest value.

note.description: What explains the change, written at a point of the line, shown when the line reaches it.

x.description: The x of the point it marks.

mode.description: predict: the learner draws the end of the line, then sees the real one over their guess.

from.description: The x of the last point shown before the guess.

hint.description: Said in the area to draw in ("Draw the line from 2023 to 2025").

button.description: The button that reveals the line ("Show me").

close.description: Feedback when the guess is within tolerance. {guess} and {actual} are the values at the last point.

far.description: Feedback otherwise. {guess} and {actual} are the values at the last point.

tolerance.description: How far from the last value a guess counts as close, in the unit of the values. Default: a tenth of the scale.

scored.description: Counts in the course score, correct when close. Off by default: predicting is a moment of engagement, not a test.

spotlightEnd.description: Narrated screens: when the voice is done with the items, so they all stand again and the highlight takes the colour. Default: the end of the line where the last item came.

revealOnBeats.description: Narrated screens with item moments: each item appears at its moment (true), or every item is there from the start and the moments only move the spotlight (false).
